title: Require diagnosis after review quality-gate failures
outcome: The review-changes command currently says to stop and present raw gate output, but does not encode the repository rule to investigate. Add a self-contained pre-review failure protocol: stop reviewer spawning, run focused diagnostics, classify the root cause without accepting flaky as a resolution, and require the original gate to pass before review resumes. Pin the contract in agent command tests.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The gate-failure protocol is in .claude/commands/review-changes.md Step 2 on master f7db2c58. Closed by evidence.
